title: Heat and mass balance case (operating point: ambient, fuel, load, power-island data)

fuel_composition.description: gas: component=mol% separated by ';' (CH4, C2H6, C3H8, iC4H10, nC4H10, C5H12, N2, CO2, O2, H2, He)

fuel_formula.description: liquid fuel as a pseudo-molecule CcHh, e.g. C12H23 (LDO)

fuel_lhv.description: liquid fuel LHV (natural gas LHV is calculated from the composition)

load_pct.description: plant net load, % of the reference case net output (100 for base-load cases)

gt_load_pct.description: GT load, % of base load at the case ambient

reference_case.description: base-load case the plant load % is measured against

gt_output.description: GT output at the generator terminals

gt_other_losses.description: GT losses not in the exhaust (lube oil, radiation), excl. generator

st_output.description: ST output at the generator terminals

hrsg_heat_loss.description: casing heat loss, % of gas-side duty

check_refs.description: limits the HMB is checked against; metric by unit: guarantee MW/kJ/kWh (Owner contract: net, internal agreement: gross or GT), K (CW rise), mbar(a) (condenser); design_parameter % of gross (aux), MJ/kg (fuel LHV), Sm3/h (gas booking), MW export (grid capacity), mbar(a)

basis_refs.description: traceability: every value cites its basis (entity:id)
